page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6a.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an AMD EPYC 7H12 processor with a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The instance is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs, derived from 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The underlying AMD processor supports hardware-assisted instruction sets including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX), Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) instructions, SHA Extensions (SHA_NI), and Fused Multiply-Add (FMA) instructions, though it lacks AVX-512 support.

Benchmark results indicate modest processing capabilities, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance scoring 756.09 (categorized in the bottom 10%) and multi-core performance scoring 3045.4 (categorized in the bottom 25%). Given these performance characteristics and the balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance is suited for general-purpose workloads with moderate CPU demands, such as web serving, development environments, and lightweight application hosting, rather than high-performance computing or intensive database operations.
